duration.text: The Reconnaissance Technology and Engineering at China University of Petroleum - Beijing is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/In total ￥ 24000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4 or above 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or equivalent or above. Above avarage in academic performance in high schools; 2. HSK Level 4; 3. (Applicants should be between the) age of 18 to 30 4. Be in good health; 5. Academic performance is above average and courses are 80% or above; 6. With basic English language ability
